title: 4541007B-Need_for_Speed_Most_Wanted.xiso.iso
queue_order: Queued by the lane (an env comparison of four arms on one build; arms.sh skips a_ref == b_ref). Common: request.sh --who drawrec1010 --title <title> --route nfs-mw-quickrace --seconds 500 --device nova --ref bf43e8c4ef --pull 'frametrace_*' --env <each of the arm's env> --expect this file, plain build. Order base, snapq, nullrec, snapq2, snapq2, nullrec, snapq, base, so no arm always runs first on a cold cache. bf43e8c4ef = lane/drawrec1010 @ 0a4976ece0 merged with origin/lane/reportasync1010 @ 0f6326deac (HAKUX_REPORT_ASYNC is not on master); the only emulator-code difference from the lane head is reports.c. HAKUX_TEXSCAN is on master. 8 runs x (500 + 90) s = 79 min, inside the addendum's 1.5 h.
judge: python3 docs/lanes/drawrec1010/proberead.py <every run of the four arms> --expect docs/testing/predictions/drawrec1010-probe.json
baseline: This lane's plain off run 1-1791670433-drawrec1010-3707918 (b10dcdb737, F1-F3 on, no DRAWREC/REPORT_ASYNC/TEXSCAN): warm countdown pace 39.2 ms/frame (18 lines), cold 43.3; vCPU (vcpuread.py, countdown -4..+1.5) 39.8 ms/frame of which busy 24.1 (NV2A wake 19.6, timer 3.6), idle 15.7, busy share 61%. Perflog pilot (952014 off / 951926 ON): ~1,600 draws/frame, 7.77 / 6.16 us/draw, of which Syn (kept by NULLREC) 3.97 / 1.91 ms/frame. Not this lane's: reportasync1010 reports ~37.5 ms warm with REPORT_ASYNC + TEXSCAN on plain (its PR.md), used for the prior only.
prediction: #433, Addendum 1: price a recorder thread before building one. All arms plain, bf43e8c4ef, F1-F3 + HAKUX_DRAWREC=1 + HAKUX_REPORT_ASYNC=1 + HAKUX_TEXSCAN=1 + HAKUX_FRAMETRACE=1 (same instrumentation in every arm; frametrace overhead is therefore in every figure, including the absolute floor, which makes the floor a slight overestimate). Arms: base; NULLREC (PFIFO skips begin_pre_draw and the recording, keeps vertex sync, staging copies, texture upload, surfaces, finishes and the rotation fence: the floor); SNAPQ=1 (base plus every draw's 40 KB RenderCommandSnapshot + payload copied to a ring and enqueued to the render thread, which frees it: the handoff's upper bound); SNAPQ=2 (the same with a ReorderWindowEntry-sized record, ~0.7 KB: the lower bound). Window: the warm countdown, go2..go12, frames ending in [mark-2, mark+1.5]. Points: base 36.5 ms/frame (range 33-40); floor (NULLREC) 29 (25-33), held by the vCPU (its busy ms/frame at the floor >= 80% of the period); SNAPQ=1 - base +3.5 ms (1.5-7: ~1,600 x 40 KB = 64 MB/frame of copy); SNAPQ=2 - base +1.0 ms (0.2-3: the per-draw enqueue's lock, signal and wake); base mid-frame GPU waits on the PFIFO thread ([probe1010] mid, any finish but FLIP_STALL/PRESENTING that waits on the GPU: non-deferred, or a rotation fence wait >= 100 us) 0.5/frame (0-2), each 2-5 ms. P(floor <= 28) 0.4, P(floor > 33) 0.15, P(SNAPQ=1 delta <= 2) 0.2, P(SNAPQ=2 delta <= 2) 0.75, P(mid <= 1/frame) 0.6. The verdict (registered here, before the runs): BUILD if floor <= 28, SNAPQ=1 delta <= 2 ms and base mid <= 1/frame. DO NOT BUILD if floor > 33, or SNAPQ=2 delta (the lower bound) > half of (base - floor); it names what holds the floor from NULLREC's frametrace and rr425w (vCPU busy, GPU waits, or vblank). Otherwise the numbers and the one deciding measurement. Using the upper bound to build and the lower bound to refuse means each verdict holds whatever the real handoff record costs between them. V requires per run 12 marks, no fatal signal, '[probe1010] waits=1 nullrec=N snapq=S' matching its env, '[drawrec1010] drawrec=1', >= 15 warm pace lines per arm, a pulled frametrace CSV, and a moving car in the base and SNAPQ arms' s*-g11.png. NULLREC draws only clears, so its frames cannot show the car; its moving player is the same timed route input as the other arms reaching the same 12 marks.
expect_note: BUILD_* / NOBUILD_* are the addendum's verdict rules; P_* are this registration's point ranges, each reported as in or out. Read by docs/lanes/drawrec1010/proberead.py. A soak writes no captures.
